interpretations.question: Should build.yaml's description be rewritten as the v1.2 delta only, or extended cumulatively to cover the current shipped capability?
interpretations.chosen: Extended the description cumulatively (V1 plus v1.1 plus the v1.2 additions) and wrote the v1.2-only delta narrative in the changelog, following the task 14.1 (v1.1) precedent.
interpretations.basis: build.yaml's description is the plugin catalog's current-capability text; the task 14.1 diff shows the v1.1 bump extended the description cumulatively and replaced the changelog with a 'v1.1 adds ...' delta paragraph. Keeping the description cumulative avoids dropping shipped v1/v1.1 capability statements, and the changelog remains the per-release delta the catalog shows for 1.2.0.0.
interpretations.impact: manifest.json (out of scope here; Phase 21 task 21.3 per the delegation) mirrors the build.yaml description/overview/changelog and must be updated to match when it is regenerated; no runtime or persisted-state effect.

interpretations.question: The task named only Version/AssemblyVersion/FileVersion in Directory.Build.props, but the file's reproducibility comment also names the declared version (it read 1.1.0.0).
interpretations.chosen: Updated the comment's version literal to 1.2.0.0 as well.
interpretations.basis: The task 14.1 precedent updated the same comment in the same way, and leaving it would make the file internally stale about its own declared version.
interpretations.impact: Comment-only; no build or artifact effect beyond the intended version bump.

interpretations.question: How precisely should the metadata phrase the restart-required classification (ADR-028 classifies a mixed setting as restart-required even though some paths apply immediately)?
interpretations.chosen: Use 'restart-required' in the description and, in the changelog, 'settings that need a host restart (a mixed setting states that some paths apply immediately)'.
interpretations.basis: docs/architecture/06 lines 125-141 and 12 lines 55-57 state that a restart-required setting's note says a Jellyfin server restart is required and a mixed setting's note also states that some paths apply immediately; the phrase 'only take effect after a host restart' would overstate the mixed settings.
interpretations.impact: Wording only; the metadata matches the shipped classification.
